summary: All rounding moved into meterbill/money.py, the context line removed, and CLI output matches the original on randomized differential runs. Context-dependent sites keep their old modes via keyword-only parameters: batch threads round half even, while bill/quote/tariffs round half up. Kept as-is: cash rule 'whole' still rounds half even (the guide's half-up mapping would change figures); values beyond 28 digits no longer crash with InvalidOperation.
